expectations.text: The response points out that 'high-end, clean, tech' are directions or adjectives rather than boundaries
expectations.evidence: The response discusses “高级、简洁、科技感” as visual styling, but never explains that these are directions or adjectives rather than boundaries.

expectations.text: The response asks for concrete things to avoid (don'ts)
expectations.evidence: It asks “你们的产品用一句不带形容词的话来说，到底是什么？谁付钱？” but does not ask what the user wants to avoid.

expectations.text: The response does not write a Ready: yes plan with the adjectives standing in as boundaries
expectations.evidence: “开始做之前，我必须先问你一件事” and “拿到答案后，我会交付” make the proposed work conditional; no Ready: yes plan is given.
